subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw make `captionedFinalText` an official channel capability and enable it for Telegram final-mode TTS by default?
rationale: The code is a plausible bug fix, but it introduces public plugin API surface and changes existing Telegram delivery semantics, which need maintainer intent beyond automated review.

options.title: Approve capability after proof
options.body: Accept the SDK capability and Telegram default once the contributor supplies current-head live Telegram proof for the changed modes.

options.title: Keep it Telegram-internal
options.body: Ask for a narrower Telegram-owned implementation if maintainers do not want to expose this as a reusable channel plugin contract yet.

options.title: Pause for delivery-mode UX
options.body: Defer this PR until the separate text-plus-voice delivery preference is resolved as a broader TTS product direction.

recommendation.title: Approve capability after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the SDK capability and Telegram default once the contributor supplies current-head live Telegram proof for the changed modes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership on the dispatch paths makes this the best available routing candidate for the capability/default decision.
